verdicts.question: Is the cable routing in the site photos continuous and consistent across the documented run — from rooftop panels to DCDB to inverter to ACDB to solar meter to main panel — with no orphan ends, no unexplained mid-run size changes, and visible conduit / cable-tie / clipping where the run is exposed?
verdicts.designer_notes: No designer answer for this target — the vision routine verifies it by tracing cables across photos with 'Cable Routing', 'Equipment Location', 'Meter Box' and similar captions on pages 4+.
verdicts.photo_observation: Pages 9-13 document the complete cable routing continuously: (1) Page 9 'Proposed PV Area' shows the panel array zone with yellow/green cable routing lines from the PV area across the rooftop; (2) Page 9 'Cable Routing' shows AC cable path from PV area toward the parapet; (3) Page 10 shows existing white PVC conduit pipe running along the parapet top and close-up of the 1-inch conduit exit hole through the parapet face; (4) Pages 11-12 show orange (AC cable) and green/yellow (AC earthing cable) lines routed down the building exterior wall from the conduit exit to ground level; (5) Page 13 shows the Main Meter panel with connection termination and proposed 'Solar Meter & Accessories' on the adjacent wall. This is an Enphase IQ8P micro-inverter system — no DCDB or string inverter exists; all output wiring is AC from the micro-inverters. Routing: roof PV array AC output through conduit pipe down parapet wall, down building exterior to main meter and new solar meter location. No orphan cable ends visible; conduit protection documented on roof/parapet section; cable clips visible on exposed wall run.
verdicts.rationale: Cable routing documented continuously across pages 9-13 from rooftop PV area through existing conduit pipe down the building wall to the meter panel. Appropriate for Enphase micro-inverter system (AC-only, no DCDB/string inverter). No orphan ends or unexplained routing gaps visible.
